ctx.link.note: ledger row: ctx.link (Hyperlink) — ctx Link opens #link-dialog in insert mode (editor.js insertLink); no post: the runner clicks post before checkEffect, which would close the dialog under assertion

ctx.edit-link.note: needs link-at-caret pre — editLinkAtSelection early-returns via setStatus('… editLink') when anchorAtSelection() finds no <a href> inside the selection (editor.js:2997-3003); the ctx-menu pre cannot build link state, so the promised #link-dialog edit mode never appears

ctx.remove-link.note: needs link-at-caret pre — removeLinkAtSelection early-returns via setStatus('… removeLink') when anchorAtSelection() finds no <a href> at the selection (editor.js:3015-3021); unlinking an anchor that cannot be planted is unassertable

ctx.clear-field.note: needs field-at-caret pre — row is data-showif="field" (index.html:1663, hidden unless .page-number/[data-field] sits at the caret) and the handler early-returns via setStatus(NoFieldAtCaret) (editor.js:9931-9944); the pre vocabulary cannot plant a field

ctx.update-field.note: KNOWN GAP: fieldOpAtSelection('update') only dispatches a fire-and-forget wo:field-op CustomEvent — no listener in editor.js, promised field-dialog slice unimplemented (editor.js:3054-3066); the runner's op-emitted observer is a stub (contract-runner.cjs:112-113), so nothing is assertable

ctx.edit-field.note: KNOWN GAP: fieldOpAtSelection('edit') only dispatches a fire-and-forget wo:field-op CustomEvent — no listener, promised #field-dialog edit slice never opens (editor.js:3054-3066); op-emitted observer is a stub (contract-runner.cjs:112-113)

ctx.toggle-field-codes.note: KNOWN GAP: fieldOpAtSelection('toggle-codes') only dispatches a fire-and-forget wo:field-op CustomEvent — no field-code view toggle exists in the DOM model (editor.js:3054-3066); op-emitted observer is a stub (contract-runner.cjs:112-113)

ctx.content-control-settings.note: needs content-control-at-caret pre — ContentControlSettings dispatches wo:content-control-settings then early-returns via setStatus(NoContentControl) when contentControlAtSelection() finds no span.content-control at the caret (editor.js:10205-10208); #cc-dialog never opens without planted content-control state
